SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.node_id) AS resolutionLinkedTdocCount FROM Company c JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sub ON sub.dst_id=c.node_id JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=sub.src_id WHERE c.companyName=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rel_REFERENCES ref JOIN Resolution r ON r.node_id=ref.src_id WHERE ref.dst_id=t.node_id)
limits: Recorded REFERENCES association, not evidence of causal success, approval, adoption, or source completeness beyond the frozen graph.
